info.name: NDC Integrations - Automated Copy 2
info.description:
Automated V2 booking flow. Select the "NDC Integrations - flydubai Automated" environment and run the whole collection in the Collection Runner (or Newman).

Flow: Search -> (UpSelling | FareConfirm) -> GetOfferBundles? -> AddPassengerDetails -> GetAncillary? -> SeatMap? -> FareCheck?
-> (Hold -> (PnrReprice? -> BookAfterHold | CancelAfterHold)) | Book -> Retrieve? / Void?

Every request reads its switch in a pre-request script and skips itself when it is off (pm.execution.skipRequest: Postman 10.13+ / Newman 6.1+).
A failed request stops the run. All ids are passed through environment variables; nothing has to be copied by hand.

Switches (environment): useUpsell, useBundle, useAncillary, useSeatMap, useFareCheck (true / false); bookingMode (Book | Hold);
afterHold (Ticket | Cancel | None); repriceBeforeTicket (true / false); finalAction (Retrieve | Void | Both | None).
Choices: offerIndex (auto or a number), upsellOfferIndex, bundleIndex, ancillaryCategory (Baggage | Meal | Any), seatPreference (Exit | Free | Any).
